data.narrative:
Sift Stack is a Series B AI & Software company that has raised $67M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable set of six same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers including Figure AI ($39.0B, Series C), Reflection AI ($25.0B, Series A), Skild AI ($14.0B, Series C), Together AI ($8.3B, Series A), and Physical Intelligence ($5.6B, Series B). The broader comp universe spans one public company (Palantir) and eight private firms.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression, using the $67M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implies a $127M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the six comparable companies yields a $11.2B implied valuation, with a range spanning $3.2B to $39.0B. The wide dispersion reflects material stage and capital-intensity variation within the AI sector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $108M (low) to $12.8B (high), with a median of $5.6B anchored by Physical Intelligence's Series B valuation. Key uncertainties include Sift Stack's revenue run-rate and unit economics relative to peers, differentiation within the crowded frontier AI market, and the sustainability of current AI sector valuations. Stage-progression alone produces a conservative floor; peer multiples suggest substantially higher fair value if execution aligns with comparable-stage companies.
